desc:
✂️ Cut REAL hair, strand by strand – and grow your barbershop into an empire!

💈 GIVE HAIRCUTS – clippers, trimmer, razor, scissors and more. Pick the right guard, match the order and earn 5 stars!
📱 GO VIRAL – every cut is filmed. Post your before & after videos to gain followers and bring in more customers.
🏗️ BUILD YOUR SHOP – grow from a corner shop to a huge salon, hire barbers who earn while you're away, and unlock better tools.
⭐ SPECIAL CUSTOMERS – celebrities, critics, big tippers and rare customers with glowing auras who pay big!
🎁 Daily rewards, quests, a Barber Pass and leaderboards.
👫 Cut together in co-op with a friend!

👍 Like and ⭐ favourite for updates! Join our group for +10% cash on every haircut.
